audit_driver_evidence.source:
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import resource
import time
from pathlib import Path

from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.moneyflow_history_receive import (
    audit_history_day,
    history_candidate_connection,
)
from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.moneyflow_history_plan import history_business_key_fields
from orchestrator.defs.paths import (
    DEFAULT_LAKE_ROOT,
    DEFAULT_LAKE_STAGING_ROOT,
    raw_moneyflow_path,
    silver_moneyflow_path,
)
from orchestrator.defs.run_contracts.moneyflow import assert_moneyflow_memory_budget

base = Path('/private/tmp/moneyflow-formal-20261009')
root = Path(DEFAULT_LAKE_STAGING_ROOT) / 'moneyflow/history-sample-20261008'
lake = Path(DEFAULT_LAKE_ROOT)
before = json.loads((base / 'before-promotion.json').read_text())
expected_hash = '19358e2bc422173cc42e6119386124a629a25f943989e52bd01a6b927ccbdc98'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
start = time.monotonic()


def check():
    assert_moneyflow_memory_budget()
    assert time.monotonic() - start < 120


audit_dir = base / 'readonly-duckdb'
audit_dir.mkdir()
audits, physical, promotions = [], {}, {}
with (root.parent / 'writer.lock').open('rb') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_SH | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    cohort = json.loads((root / 'cohort.json').read_text())
    progress = json.loads((root / 'progress.json').read_text())
    assert cohort == before['cohort'] and cohort['cohort_hash'] == expected_hash
    assert progress['stage'] == 'files_complete'
    assert progress['promoted_files'] == 28 and progress['promoted_dates'] == 14
    assert progress['promoted_rows'] == 29783 and progress['copy_transactions'] == 42
    assert progress['reviewed_cohort_hash'] == expected_hash
    assert progress['reservation_seconds'] == 0
    assert progress['closed_units'] == before['preflight_result']['closed_units']
    with history_candidate_connection(audit_dir, check) as db:
        for name, item in before['candidate_receipts'].items():
            check()
            checkpoint = root / name
            assert sha(checkpoint) == item['sha256']
            receipt = json.loads(checkpoint.read_text())
            ds = next(x['dataset'] for x in progress['closed_units']
                      if x['checkpoint_sha256'] == item['sha256'])
            assert receipt['difference_count'] == 0 and not receipt['difference_samples']
            assert receipt['source_proof']['rows'] == receipt['verification_proof']['rows'] == receipt['expected_rows']
            assert receipt['source_proof']['date_counts'] == receipt['verification_proof']['date_counts']
            assert receipt['source_proof']['scope_counts'] == receipt['verification_proof']['scope_counts']
            promotion_path = checkpoint.parent / 'promotion.json'
            promotion = json.loads(promotion_path.read_text())
            assert promotion['stage'] == 'complete'
            assert all(x['status'] == 'complete' and x['mode'] == 'move' for x in promotion['files'].values())
            promotions[str(promotion_path.relative_to(root))] = {'sha256':sha(promotion_path), 'receipt':promotion}
            for fact in receipt['files']:
                day = fact['trade_date']
                raw, silver = raw_moneyflow_path(lake, ds, day), silver_moneyflow_path(lake, ds, day)
                count = audit_history_day(db, raw, silver, day, dataset=ds)
                assert count == fact['rows']
                scope = []
                for layer, path in (('raw',raw),('silver',silver)):
                    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
                    assert list(path.parent.glob('*.parquet')) == [path]
                    assert sha(path) == fact[layer + '_sha256']
                    assert path.stat().st_size == promotion['files'][day+'/'+layer]['size']
                    key_sql = ','.join('"'+k+'"' for k in history_business_key_fields(ds))
                    rows, keys = db.execute('SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT ('+key_sql+')) FROM read_parquet(?,hive_partitioning=false)',[str(path)]).fetchone()
                    assert rows == keys == count
                    physical[str(path)] = {'dataset':ds,'day':day,'layer':layer,'rows':rows,'keys':keys,'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(path)}
                    if ds == 'moneyflow_ind_dc' and layer == 'raw':
                        scope = db.execute('SELECT content_type,count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE ts_code IS NULL) FROM read_parquet(?,hive_partitioning=false) GROUP BY content_type ORDER BY content_type',[str(path)]).fetchall()
                audits.append({'dataset':ds,'day':day,'source_rows':fact['rows'],'normalized_rows':count,'raw_rows':count,'silver_rows':count,'source_difference_count':receipt['difference_count'],'schema_date_keys_field_equality':'passed','scope_counts_and_null_codes':scope})
    assert len(audits) == 14 and len(physical) == 28
    assert sum(a['source_rows'] for a in audits) == 29783
    assert not list(root.rglob('*.parquet')) and not list(root.rglob('*.partial'))
    assert json.loads((root/'progress.json').read_text()) == progress
    metadata_proofs = {str(p.relative_to(root)):json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in (root/'metadata').rglob('proof.json')}
    executed_sql = {str(p.relative_to(root)):{'sha256':sha(p),'sql':p.read_text()} for p in root.rglob('source.sql')}
    assert len(metadata_proofs) == 14 and len(executed_sql) == 42
result = {'kind':'real approved two-date Prod-to-formal-Lake sample; final read-only audit',
          'cohort':cohort,'progress':progress,'audits':audits,'formal_files':physical,
          'formal_bytes':sum(p['bytes'] for p in physical.values()),'candidate_checkpoints_unchanged':True,
          'promotion_receipts':promotions,'metadata_proofs':metadata_proofs,'executed_sql':executed_sql,
          'candidate_parquet_remaining':0,'partial_files_remaining':0,'source_connections':42,
          'source_sql_statements':168,'source_difference_count':0,'normalization_rejects':0,
          'duckdb_audit_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'audit_peak_rss_bytes':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
          'formal_audit_writes':0,'dagster_instance_events_partitions_written':0,'prod_writes':0}
(base/'audit-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ('formal_bytes','candidate_checkpoints_unchanged','candidate_parquet_remaining','source_connections','source_difference_count','normalization_rejects','duckdb_audit_seconds','audit_peak_rss_bytes')}))
